description: React component 'AssetPropertiesTab' displays a table of asset properties fetched from an API endpoint. It manages loading and error states, and renders property name, value, and active status in a DataTable component. The component is part of a larger asset details page, providing a tab specifically for asset properties.

methods.name: AssetPropertiesTab
methods.description: React functional component rendering asset properties within a tab panel, handling data fetch, display, and permissions.
